text: RWB-E1-011 is split four ways in the target: rwb-source-data owns the enterprise run ReconciliationWorkflow, reconciliation_result, REC-01's account count and balance, REC-02 and the case-list publish gate; rwb-case owns the case-side facts - the exclusion list of REC-01, the plan link of REC-03 and the referential check of REC-05 over recovery_case, case_account, case_party and case_entry_exclusion; rwb-asset and rwb-comms own their own referential slices; rwb-ITG proves the whole of JOB-04 end to end. The rwb-case slice writes no row of reconciliation_result, owns no legacy acceptance criterion, and treats the platform CONs of its DP table (RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1042-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, RWB-PLT-E1071-CON, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON) and its own contracts RWB-P3-E1042-CON and RWB-P3-E1043-CON as present before the wave-1 build rather than as build dependencies, so Depends on (build) and Contract dependencies stay None as the plan sets them.
why: The plan gives a secondary rwb-case slice of the key with empty H, C, I and X lists and no legacy criterion, while the legacy story is a single shared JOB-04 step and no source draws the boundary; without a ruling the story cannot be scoped, its tables cannot be placed and the lane cannot be cut.

text: The case-side run writes its own tables in schema rwb_case - case_quality_run (unique business_date), case_quality_result (unique rec_code, quality_check, business_date, product_group, with the legacy reconciliation_result column names of DF-OPS-118 to DF-OPS-129) and case_quality_break (index on business_date together with rec_code, and on key_type together with key_value) - created by V1011_1__case_quality.sql in the per-service Flyway sequence; the three check names are EXCL under REC-01, PLAN under REC-03 and KEY under REC-05, the result values are PASS, BREAK and not run, and reconciliation_result itself stays rwb-source-data's table and is never written or read here.
why: The legacy result table belongs to another service in the target and the case slice needs a durable result, a run record and a break list, but no source names them or their keys.

confirm: Solution architect with the rwb-case service owner and the ACE team in the migration review of V1011_1.
impact: If the tables or the keys are named otherwise, section 11, one row of 12.7, one fake, the migration and the two criteria AC1 and AC6 change; no operation or workflow changes.

text: The case-side run is answered by four operations on /api/recovery/case/v1 - GET /quality-runs/{businessDate} with Platform administration R, GET /quality-results with Platform administration R and Reporting R, GET /reconciliation/status with Platform administration R and the rwb-source-data service identity, and POST /quality-runs/{businessDate}/rerun with Platform administration U and an Idempotency-Key - all read only except the rerun, answering 400, 401, 403, 404, 409 and 503 with the problem body of the rwb-case service contract and never recomputing a variance at the boundary; the run publishes no Kafka record, because the case event catalogue carries no reconciliation event, and the run record goes to the local decision record instead.
why: AC1, AC2, AC4, AC5, AC7 and TC-E1-011-07 read and restart a run that the legacy story exposed through a job listing and a scheduler console, and no source gives the target operations, rights or response shapes.

text: The ACE side of every case-side check arrives through the rwb-source-data contract and never through a recovery.v_ace_* view: the freshness read GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/data-products/freshness answers COMPLETE or STALE with the last complete business date per data product, and one product-coded records read per data product answers the rows of the business date in force - account key, days past due and balance for the accounts product, person key for the customer product, and plan reference, booked date and plan status for the plans product, which is the plan side of REC-03 and REC-05 for a recovery_case.plan_ref. Every call is one hop with a 2 s timeout, one GET retry with jitter and a breaker, and is faked from Day 1.
why: The legacy story reads six ACE views directly and the target gives the views to rwb-source-data alone, so the checks of AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4 and AC7 cannot run without a read shape for the accounts, customer and plan rows, and no source states it.

text: The case service never writes the case list: it answers GET /api/recovery/case/v1/reconciliation/status for a business date with RELEASED, HELD or NOT_RUN and the count of unexplained exclusions per product group, and the case-list gate of rwb-source-data reads that answer before it releases the case list. A break or an incomplete data product therefore holds the case list of the date through that answer, and the rerun of AC5 is the only path that releases it.
why: AC2 and AC4 keep the legacy behaviour of holding the case list and case_list_row.publish_status is rwb-source-data's table in the target, so the verdict must cross the service boundary in a named shape that no source gives.

text: The case links stay the ACE business keys: case_account.account_key, case_party.person_key, recovery_case.primary_person_key and case_entry_exclusion.account_key, held as varchar with the legacy field IDs DF-CAS-026, DF-CAS-032, DF-CAS-004 and DF-CAS-057, with no foreign key inside or across a schema; the account_id and party_id uuid cross-references of TSD P3 v3 are read as the pre-D-RCV-35 form, and the referential check of REC-05 is done by the run rather than by a constraint.
why: AC7, BR5 and the migration all depend on the column form, and the technical and functional specifications disagree: TSD P3 v3 declares uuid cross-references while the FSD re-base under D-RCV-35 and the legacy data table use the business keys.

impact: If the uuid form is ruled, the three link columns, AC7, BR5 and the migration change, and the referential check moves partly into the database; no operation changes.

text: The case-side facts reach the reader through the read operations of this service: rwb-reporting reads GET /quality-results for the report of the date, the admin surface renders GET /quality-runs/{businessDate} through the gateway-bff composite route, and no extract file, outbound item, lake path or Power BI data set is produced. One Schedule with SKIP overlap and the workflow-kit catch-up window starts the run after the morning ACE batch window, its cron set at deployment, the three legacy alert groups (data steward, platform administrator, team manager) are configuration, and the switch is the platform flag rwb.p3.case-quality-run.
why: DP-17 removes the lake, the two extracts and the 07:30 report the legacy story reports through, and no source names the replacement reader, the cron, the alert groups or a flag in the target form.
